All RHEL 9 and 10 zips are full builds which means that even SPs always include all the conf files. This means that each SP overrides the existing configuration including all customer changes.

items.fromString:
Applying JBCS Apache Httpd 2.4.62 SP1 causes service startup failure due to overridden configuration files.

 
{code:java}
[root@ibm-p8-kvm-03-guest-02 conf]# cd /tmp/jbcs-httpd24-2.4/httpd/sbin/
[root@ibm-p8-kvm-03-guest-02 sbin]# ./apachectl start 
httpd: Could not open configuration file /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf: No such file or directory
{code}
After applying the *JBCS Apache Httpd 2.4.62 SP1* update, the JBCS service fails to start.
It was observed that files in the following directories (not limited to) get *overridden* during the patching process:
 * conf/
 * conf.d/
 * conf.modules.d/

In particular, critical configuration files such as httpd.conf, ssl.conf, apachectl, etc., are replaced with default versions.

As a result, any {*}custom changes previously applied are lost{*}, leading to misconfiguration and service startup failure.

*Steps to Reproduce:*
 * Install JBCS Apache Httpd 2.4.62.
 * Apply {*}SP1 patch{*}.
 * Attempt to start the JBCS service.
 * Observe that:
 ** Startup fails.
 ** Custom configurations & paths (from httpd.conf, ssl.conf, apachectl, etc) are missing.

*Expected Behavior:*
 * Applying the SP1 patch should preserve existing customizations in conf, conf.d, conf.modules.d & sbin.
 * Service should start successfully post-patch.

*Impact:*
 * Service is down post-patch.
 * Manual re-application of custom configurations is required with the rerun of the `sh .postinstall` script after deleting .postinstall.httpd.done file.
 * Risk of missing/incorrect re-configuration during restoration.

items.fromString:
mod_proxy_http2 + mod_proxy_connect prematurely closes connections (Apache HTTPD 2.4.62)

How to reproduce the issue:
1. install JBCS httpd 2.4.62 on RHEL8
2. copy the attached config files on RHEL8
3. modify /etc/hosts as follows:

127.0.0.1   fproxy.example.com host14.example.com localhost localhost.localdomain localhost4 localhost4.localdomain4

4. access the httpd as follows:

    h2load -c 1 -m 1 -n 1 https://host14.example.com/proxy/

or

    curl -v -k --http2 https://host14.example.com/proxy/

The connection from httpd to the forward proxy is not being kept alive. On the other hand, it is maintained in version 2.4.57.

We encountered apache service startup error in UOB SPL Production Web Server (Oracle Solaris 11.4 SPARC).  The outstanding error as we observed is below for Apache/2.4.46. I attached full log as well.

Please kindly look into the issue and get back to us asap. Thanks

[Tue Oct 29 14:37:07.201092 2024] [mpm_event:notice] [pid 1393:tid 1] AH00491: caught SIGTERM, shutting down
[Tue Oct 29 14:38:25.597355 2024] [weblogic:notice] [pid 3579:tid 1] WebLogic Server Plugin version 12.2.1.4.0 <WLSPLUGINS_12.2.1.4.0_SOLARIS.SPARC64_190912.1848>
[Tue Oct 29 14:38:25.714543 2024] [mpm_event:notice] [pid 3579:tid 1] AH00489: Apache/2.4.46 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.2zj configured -- resuming normal operations
[Tue Oct 29 14:38:25.714801 2024] [core:notice] [pid 3579:tid 1] AH00094: Command line: '/app/apache/TKMMY/bin/httpd'

 

Regards,

Mike

Dear support,

We encountered apache service startup error in UOB SPL Production Web Server (Oracle Solaris 11.4 SPARC), causing the  service can't receive any Prod request traffic.   The outstanding error as we observed is below for Apache/2.4.46. I attached full log as well.

Please kindly look into the issue and get back to us asap. Thanks

[Tue Oct 29 14:37:07.201092 2024] [mpm_event:notice] [pid 1393:tid 1] AH00491: caught SIGTERM, shutting down
[Tue Oct 29 14:38:25.597355 2024] [weblogic:notice] [pid 3579:tid 1] WebLogic Server Plugin version 12.2.1.4.0 <WLSPLUGINS_12.2.1.4.0_SOLARIS.SPARC64_190912.1848>
[Tue Oct 29 14:38:25.714543 2024] [mpm_event:notice] [pid 3579:tid 1] AH00489: Apache/2.4.46 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.2zj configured – resuming normal operations
[Tue Oct 29 14:38:25.714801 2024] [core:notice] [pid 3579:tid 1] AH00094: Command line: '/app/apache/TKMMY/bin/httpd'

 

Regards,

Mike
